name: Undergraduate Student Alliance of Computer Scientists (USACS)
description: Rutgers' main CS student org. Runs tech talks, coding workshops, interview prep and social events for anyone interested in computer science.

name: HackRU
description: Organizes HackRU, Rutgers' student-run hackathon held every semester, plus workshops for building projects and learning new tech.

name: Rutgers IEEE
description: Student branch of IEEE for electrical and computer engineering. Hosts hardware workshops, project teams, company info sessions and socials.

name: Society of Women Engineers (SWE)
description: Supports women in engineering and technology through mentorship, professional development, outreach and community events.

name: National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE)
description: Community and professional development for Black engineering and STEM students, with career fairs, study sessions and conference trips.

name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers (SHPE)
description: Supports Hispanic and Latinx students in STEM through networking, academic support, career prep and cultural community.

name: Rutgers Blueprint
description: Students build free software for nonprofits. Members work on real client projects as developers, designers and product managers.

name: Rutgers Formula Racing
description: Designs, builds and races a formula-style car for the Formula SAE competition. Open to all majors: mechanical, electrical, business and more.

name: Rutgers Data Science Club
description: Workshops and projects in data analysis, machine learning and Python for students of any skill level.

name: Rutgers Esports
description: Competitive and casual gaming community with teams for popular titles, watch parties and game nights.

name: Rutgers University Programming Association (RUPA)
description: Plans big campus events like concerts, comedy shows and festivals. Often has free food and giveaways.

name: Rutgers University Student Assembly
description: Rutgers' student government. Represents students to the administration and funds student organizations.

name: Rutgers University Debate Union
description: Competitive parliamentary debate team. Travels to tournaments and welcomes beginners.

name: Rutgers Model United Nations
description: Simulates UN committees at conferences, building skills in diplomacy, research and public speaking.

name: Rutgers University Dance Marathon (RUDM)
description: Year-long fundraising that ends in a 32-hour dance marathon supporting children and families facing illness.

name: Rutgers Habitat for Humanity
description: Volunteers build and repair affordable housing and raise awareness about housing insecurity.

name: Rutgers Outdoors Club
description: Hiking, camping, kayaking and climbing trips for all experience levels, with gear available to borrow.

name: The Daily Targum
description: Rutgers' independent student newspaper. Join as a writer, photographer, editor or on the business side.

name: WRSU Radio
description: Rutgers' student-run radio station. DJ your own show, cover sports, or work in news and production.

name: Rutgers Muslim Student Association (MSA)
description: Faith, community and service for Muslim students and anyone curious, with weekly events, iftars and volunteering.

name: Rutgers Hillel
description: Center for Jewish life at Rutgers, with Shabbat dinners, holidays, trips and social events.

name: Rutgers Korean Student Association (KSA)
description: Celebrates Korean culture through socials, food events, performances and mentorship.

name: Rutgers Bhangra
description: Competitive Punjabi folk dance team that performs at campus events and competes nationally.

name: Rutgers Chess Club
description: Casual and competitive chess for every level, with weekly meetups and tournaments.

name: American Medical Student Association (AMSA) at Rutgers
description: For pre-med students: MCAT advice, physician speakers, shadowing and clinical opportunities.

name: Rutgers Entrepreneurship Society
description: For aspiring founders: startup workshops, pitch nights, founder speakers and networking.
